logline: When Gerald and his spiteful companion arrive at the woodland cottage to mock Juliana's fallen status, her stoic new husband returns from the forest to silently send them fleeing.
continuity_notes: Follows Episode 6, where Juliana found refuge and warmth beside the hearth with her mysterious husband; morning brings unwelcome visitors from her former life to their humble doorstep.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Juliana kneeling on the cold, damp ground outside the stone cottage, pulling weeds from the dirt with her bare hands.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana, dressed in her simple grey long-sleeved gown, works tirelessly with soil caked beneath her fingernails.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle tracking shot as an ornate black-and-gold carriage with crest emblazoned on the door rolls to a stop on the muddy path outside the gate.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Heavy carriage wheels grinding in mud, horse snorts, and rhythmic hoofbeats halting.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot as Aristocratic Woman steps out of the carriage into the misty air, shielding herself under an intricate lace parasol in an elegant lavender gown.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Gerald steps down from the carriage behind her, looking immaculate in a high-collared navy frock coat, white waistcoat, and dark cravat.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Aristocratic Woman smirks cruelly as she surveys the humble stone cottage.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana rinses the heavy mud from her hands in a cold rainwater puddle and rises to her feet, holding her head high.

events.label: ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN (Mocking, Condescending)
events.content: "This is where you live now?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Gerald standing beside Aristocratic Woman, sneering disdainfully.

events.label: GERALD (Arrogant, Scornful)
events.content: "A fitting home for a woman who threw away everything for a penniless soldier."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Juliana, defiant and unflinching despite her soiled dress and damp hair.

events.label: JULIANA (Sharp, Unintimidated)
events.content: "You came all this way just to insult my home?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Aristocratic Woman erupting into high-pitched, malicious laughter beneath her parasol.

events.label: ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN (Gloating, Mocking)
events.content: "Home? Look at your hands, Juliana."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana's mud-stained palms held open against her apron.

events.label: ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN (O.S.) (Cruel)
events.content: "You look like a servant."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Gerald's smug expression watching Juliana.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Juliana lifting her chin with unwavering dignity.

events.label: JULIANA (Proud, Resolute)
events.content: "I work with my hands. There is no shame in that."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Gerald's tightening jaw.

events.label: GERALD (Biting, Condescending)
events.content: "You were born a lady."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Juliana's clear blue eyes, shining with unbroken pride.

events.label: JULIANA (Firm, Unapologetic)
events.content: "And I remain one."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide shot framing Juliana facing off against Gerald and Aristocratic Woman in the bleak courtyard.

events.label: GERALD (Bitter, Sneering)
events.content: "You chose that scarred beggar over a life of comfort."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Two-shot profile of Juliana looking straight into Gerald's eyes without flinching.

events.label: JULIANA (Passionate, Defiant)
events.content: "I chose a man who stood beside me when you walked away."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Intense close-up of Juliana dismissing him with utter contempt.

events.label: JULIANA (Cold, Commanding)
events.content: "You have no authority here. Leave."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Gerald lunging forward, aggressively pointing his finger into Juliana's face.

events.label: GERALD (Furious, Threatening)
events.content: "I have enough influence to make a beggar disappear."

events.label: GERALD (Spiteful, Boastful)
events.content: "And your husband?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide shot down a dark, fog-drenched forest path. A towering, shadowed figure walks steadily forward through the mist.

events.label: GERALD (V.O.) (Snarl)
events.content: "Where is that beggar husband?"

events.label: ACTION
events.content: The Scarred Bearded Man marches purposefully toward the cottage, carrying a heavy bundle of chopped firewood bound tightly with hemp cord.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium tracking shot pushing in on the Scarred Bearded Man's stern, rugged face as he approaches the gate.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low shot of the Scarred Bearded Man bending down and dropping the bundle of logs by the stone wall.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: A dull, heavy thud of timber striking the mud.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium full shot as the Scarred Bearded Man straightens to his full imposing height and steps directly toward Gerald.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Two-shot framing the Scarred Bearded Man towering menacingly over Gerald, staring down at him with unyielding intensity.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Gerald freezes, his arrogant bravado instantly vanishing as cold dread overtakes his face.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle close-up of Gerald looking up in sheer terror, his adam's apple bobbing nervously.

events.label: ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN (O.S.) (Urgent, Annoyed)
events.content: "Gerald, don't let him frighten you."

events.label: GERALD (Trembling, Trying to Save Face)
events.content: "What are you staring at?"

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Gerald rapidly turns on his heel toward the carriage, unwilling to face another second of the silent glare.

events.label: GERALD (Nervous, Hurried)
events.content: "We are leaving."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Aristocratic Woman, shocked and indignant as Gerald flees past her.

events.label: ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN (Outraged, Flustered)
events.content: "Leaving? Gerald!"

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Aristocratic Woman scrambles back into the carriage, hiking up her gown in a fluster before slamming the door shut.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Carriage door slamming shut.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide shot of the carriage rapidly jolting forward and disappearing down the misty road away from the cottage.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium profile two-shot of Juliana turning toward the Scarred Bearded Man, her eyes gleaming with genuine admiration.

events.label: JULIANA (Impressed, Softly Amused)
events.content: "You didn't say a word."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on the Scarred Bearded Man looking down at her, his rugged features softening with quiet affection.

events.label: SCARRED BEARDED MAN (Low, Gentle, Confident)
events.content: "I didn't need to."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot as the Scarred Bearded Man stoops down, scoops up the heavy bundle of firewood in one arm, and walks calmly past Juliana toward their door.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana looking after him, a radiant and grateful smile blooming across her face as the scene fades out.
